gloss: along the way; on the road; while walking

definitions.gloss: along the way; on the road; while walking
definitions.explanation: While traveling along a road or path. Describes something done or observed during a journey. A literary and somewhat elegant expression.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}すがら⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I admired the flowers along the way.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}すがら⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ばったり→ばったり：03701_battari⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I happened to run into a friend on the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}すがら、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あれこれ→あれこれ：22192_arekore⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: On the way to the station, I recalled various memories from the past.

notes:
A literary adverb with an elegant, slightly old-fashioned feel. More evocative than the everyday ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on the way). Often appears in essays, fiction, and travel writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — on the way (neutral, everyday)
- {道|みち}すがら — along the way (literary, evocative)
- ⟦{道中|どうちゅう}→道中：14427_douchuu⟧ — during a journey (slightly formal)

The すがら element is a classical particle meaning "while; along" and is not productive in modern Japanese.
